name: lynx-gmti
label: Lynx SAR/GMTI (GA-ASI class)
description: Medium-altitude tactical radar: smaller areas, faster revisits and finer plots than wide-area MTI.
basis: A nominal starting point for this class of sensor from public descriptions, not tuned on its own recordings: score it on yours with scripts/benchmark (bench run --profile) and adjust. Clutter density as gmti-wide-area (2e-7); gmti-high-clutter shows the stricter choice.
